verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows marketing-chat snippets implying an onboarding/migration process ("we'll map it during onboarding, and I'll include a migration checklist") and general customizable data-model docs, but nothing demonstrating a concrete self-serve import flow, time-to-value benchmarks, or independent confirmation of a sub-hour setup without help. missing for 10: self-serve CSV/import wizard documentation, concrete time-to-value evidence, independent/hands-on onboarding reports, confirmation no implementation partner is needed.
